answer: Each agent stakes a unique non-reusable marble token bound to a personal trellis of sequential delay proofs. Every epoch it solves a non-parallelizable VDF on its marble seed; the trellis links proofs so the k-th clone needs k times the serial compute plus a fresh marble. An honest agent pays only its 45-second VDF once; a farm of 200 pays 200 marbles and 200 serial cores for the epoch window or forfeits its sable bond. Cost cannot be shared: the trellis verifies one-to-one marble ownership on-chain.
